interpretation: Synthetic Wi-Fi client, AP transmitter and forwarded application-endpoint source. The AP transmits frames carrying the endpoint source MAC.

client_key_encoding.finding: Source inspection found that the quoted wpa_supplicant PSK parser does not decode JSON escapes; earlier simple-key runs did not exercise this.
client_key_encoding.change: Use standard-library PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1, 4096 iterations and 32 bytes, serialized as the supported raw hexadecimal PSK.
client_key_encoding.validation: Final selected change uses a literal quote and backslash; both positive and wrong-key cases are required.
